## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S2. This is audit backlog UX-09 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Board Done card, desk patient record, schedule · receptionist.
Findings and reviewers: F-06 · reviewer A-07. A verified defect against an acceptance line of MDV-P2-043.
Rationale: The doctor's screen says The front desk will book it from Tuesday, 17 November 2026. The desk sees nothing. Chronic-care patients are not rebooked unless they ask.
Proposed UX behaviour: The Done card and the desk patient record show Follow-up due from 17 Nov · Book. Book opens the booking panel on that date with the patient and doctor chosen. The line clears when the follow-up is booked, or when the desk dismisses it with a reason. The desk sees the date and the doctor only, never the note or the reason for the follow-up.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, receptionist view, desk jobs beside the queue (audit note 10).
Components and tokens affected: Board card, desk record, booking panel. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end; back end exposes the follow-up date to desk roles through an application contract of the encounters module (no cross-module table access), with no clinical text.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None.
Clinical sign-off: Not required. The receptionist confirms in the session (receptionist scenario step 5).
Effort and regression risk: M · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Automatic booking. (2) Reminders to the patient. (3) Care-plan tasks (P4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the doctor set a follow-up of 2 weeks and ended the visit, when the receptionist opens the board and the patient's desk record, then both show Follow-up due from the date with Book
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the line, when Book is pressed, then the booking panel opens on that date with the patient and doctor chosen
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the follow-up is booked or dismissed with a reason, when the board refreshes, then the line is gone and a dismissal is audited
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a desk role, when the follow-up is returned by the API, then it holds the date and doctor and no note text, and the test fails if clinical text is added
- [ ] **AC5.** Given that ticket's line The follow-up choice appears on the front desk's list for that patient, when the journey runs, then it passes on the real stack
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs on the card and the record, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- Integration: the contract's role scope and tenant isolation.
- Playwright J2 to J3 handoff (fullstack): doctor sets 2 weeks → receptionist sees and books it.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
